NARRATOR.say: in a deep, low, suspenseful Telugu movie-trailer narrator voice, mixing Telugu and English naturally, with short dramatic pauses

lines.text: ఒక secret laboratory లో, something terrifying జరిగింది.
lines.sub: Oka secret laboratory lo… something terrifying jarigindi.

lines.text: Meanwhile, Mike, Dustin, Lucas, and Will, Dungeons and Dragons ఆడుతున్నారు.
lines.sub: Meanwhile… Mike, Dustin, Lucas, and Will… Dungeons and Dragons aaduthunnaru.

lines.text: Game అయ్యాక, Will bicycle మీద ఇంటికి return అవుతున్నాడు.
lines.sub: Game ayyaka… Will bicycle meeda intiki return avuthunnadu.

lines.text: But ఆ night, అతని life completely change అయ్యింది.
lines.sub: But aa night… athani life completely change ayyindi.

lines.text: Dark forest లో, ఒక mysterious creature, Will ని chase చేసింది.
lines.sub: Dark forest lo… oka mysterious creature… Will ni chase chesindi.

lines.text: His mother Joyce, తన son కోసం desperate గా search చేస్తుంది.
lines.sub: His mother Joyce… tana son kosam desperate ga search chesthundi.

lines.text: Chief Hopper, ఈ disappearance వెనక secret ఉందని suspect చేస్తాడు.
lines.sub: Chief Hopper… ee disappearance venaka secret undani suspect chesthadu.

lines.text: Meanwhile, Will friends, forest లో ఒక mysterious girl ని discover చేస్తారు.
lines.sub: Meanwhile… Will friends… forest lo oka mysterious girl ni discover chestharu.

lines.text: But, she knows something about Will.
lines.sub: But… she knows something about Will.

lines.text: And Hawkins లో, real nightmare ఇప్పుడే start అయ్యింది.
lines.sub: And Hawkins lo… real nightmare ippude start ayyindi.
